# HypurrfiArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/HypurrfiArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
HypurrfiArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Hypurrfi.

Implements strategy for supplying tokens, withdrawing tokens, and claiming rewards on Hypurrfi.
Hypurrfi is a fork of Aave V3 with some modifications, includiung Frax v3 isolated lending pools.


## State Variables
### aToken
The Hypurrfi aToken address


```solidity
address public immutable aToken
```


### hypurrfiPool
The Hypurrfi pool address


```solidity
IHypurrfiPool public immutable hypurrfiPool
```


### rewardsController
The Hypurrfi rewards controller address


```solidity
IRewardsController public immutable rewardsController
```

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

### _isActive

HELPERS

Checks if the reserve is active based on the configuration data

**Parameters**

### _isPaused

Checks if the reserve is paused based on the configuration data

A pool can be paused by the Aave governance to stop all actions on the reserve in case of an emergency


